overloadMerges.note: dbEvent, tableNum, and recordNum are documented '<-' (filled/returned by the command) in the parameter table; only triggerLevel is '->' (input). Autoparse defaulted all four to direction:in. Also adds sentinelValues for dbEvent's documented constants (Trigger Events theme).

params.name: triggerLevel
params.description: Trigger execution cycle level to query (see Trigger level)

params.name: dbEvent
params.description: Filled with the database event that triggered execution at triggerLevel

sentinelValues.meaning: triggerLevel does not correspond to an existing trigger execution level (all output params are set to 0 in this case)

params.name: tableNum
params.description: Filled with the number of the table involved by the database event at triggerLevel

params.name: recordNum
params.description: Filled with the number of the record involved by the database event at triggerLevel

constraints: Used together with Trigger level to perform different actions depending on the cascading of trigger execution levels.
If triggerLevel does not correspond to an existing trigger execution level, the command fills dbEvent, tableNum, and recordNum with 0.
